game.name: Call Of Juarez (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es)
game.desc: Call of Juarez on Xbox 360 is a first-person shooter set in the Wild West. Play as two iconic characters: Billy, a young fugitive accused of murder, and Reverend Ray, a repentant bandit convinced he is the instrument of divine justice. Two heroes for two radically different ways of playing, each with their own set of moves and of course, their own inventory.
